identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Gamer aesthetics with Military HUD precision.
Emotion First: The UI should feel 'alive' and 'monitoring'.
Content is King: Data (Status) is the hero.
Negative Space: Use deep black voids to make neon pop.

usage.code: JetBrains Mono, monospace (for data values, IP addresses, IDs)

visual_enhancers.scanlines: background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.06), rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.02), rgba(0, 0, 255, 0.06)); background-size: 100% 2px, 3px 100%;

StatusCard.description: Main display for user status. Uses a 'holographic' card style.
StatusCard.style: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-primary/30 rounded-none relative overflow-hidden

AudioVisualizer.description: Simulated audio bars that react to 'speaking' state.
AudioVisualizer.implementation: Row of 10-20 div bars. Use framer-motion to randomize height when speaking=true, flatten when speaking=false.

InfoPanel.description: Displays Server Name, Channel, Member Count.
InfoPanel.style: Grid of smaller cards. Use 'JetBrains Mono' for the numbers to look like data streams.

Background.description: Cyberpunk city or grid texture with heavy overlay.
Background.style: Fixed, cover, z-[-1]. Overlay with radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 0%, #030305 100%) to fade edges.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. SETUP THEME: Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the custom colors (cyber-cyan, glitch-red, etc) and fonts.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the Google Fonts import to `index.css` and set the body background to #030305.
5. MOCK DATA: Since backend might not be ready, create a `useDiscordStatus` hook that simulates status changes (cycling through online/speaking/idle) for the demo.
6. VISUALIZER LOGIC: The visualizer should be a 'dummy' visualizer that animates randomly when `status === 'speaking'`.
7. NO SCROLLBARS: Hide scrollbars for a clean 'app' feel (`::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
